comparison.objective: Sort visually similar cubes according to whether they float.
comparison.physical_skill: Experimental placement in fluid, observation of buoyancy, retrieval, and sorting.
comparison.success_condition: Cubes are sorted by float behavior. Spill, retrieval, and classification thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Buoyancy-based classification does not test coaxial impact tooling, controlled fracture, insert retention, or containment of released tangs.
